name: routing
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific request or problem is the customer raising? Pick the option that best matches the customer's main need.

criteria.card_activation: How to activate a newly received card, or whether it needs activating.
criteria.card_ordering_physical: Getting or ordering a physical (plastic) card, including how to apply for one.
criteria.card_spare_or_additional: Getting an extra, second or additional card on the same account, e.g. for a family member.
criteria.card_virtual: Getting, finding or using a virtual card (not disposable).
criteria.card_disposable_virtual: Disposable / single-use virtual cards: what they are, how to get one, how many uses or how many can be made.
criteria.card_virtual_not_working: A virtual or disposable card that is rejected or not working.
criteria.card_delivery: When an ordered card will arrive, delivery time, delivery tracking, or a new card that has not arrived.
criteria.card_expiring: The card is about to expire or has expired; getting a replacement for expiry.
criteria.card_brand: Questions about which card network or card type the customer gets: whether the bank offers, issues or accepts Visa or Mastercard, which one the customer will get or can choose, what credit cards the bank provides, or wanting a particular card network.
criteria.card_linking: Adding, linking or re-adding a card to the app, including a card that was reported or thought lost and has since been found, which the customer wants to use again.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card and the customer wants it back or needs a new one.
criteria.card_pin: Card PIN: where to find it, how to set or change it, PIN not received.
criteria.card_pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked or locked after wrong attempts, or the PIN is rejected.
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card has stopped working in general, without a specific declined payment or ATM detail.
criteria.card_payment_declined: A card payment at a shop or online was declined or refused.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which shops or ATMs take the card.
criteria.card_replacement_cost: Cost of ordering a replacement or additional card.
criteria.transfer_pending: An outgoing transfer is still pending or has not gone through yet.
criteria.transfer_not_received: A transfer was sent but the recipient says it has not arrived.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive, in general or from a particular country.
criteria.transfer_failed: A transfer failed or could not be made.
criteria.transfer_cancel: The customer wants to cancel a transfer they made.
criteria.transfer_beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer cannot send money to a particular recipient or beneficiary.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or receive money into this account from another bank or person, including salary.
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: An incoming bank transfer has not appeared in the balance.
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: A cheque or cash deposit has not appeared in the balance.
criteria.card_payment_pending: A card payment is still pending or not completed.
criteria.card_payment_reverted: A card payment was reverted, cancelled or returned.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_pending: An ATM cash withdrawal still shows as pending.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_declined: The customer could not withdraw cash at an ATM, the withdrawal was declined, or the app shows a withdrawal but no cash came out.
criteria.topup_how: How to top up or add money to the account, which methods are possible (card, bank transfer, cash, cheque, Apple Pay, Google Pay).
criteria.topup_failed: A top-up failed, was declined or did not work, or money the customer tried to add has vanished or is not in the balance.
criteria.topup_pending: A top-up is still pending or the customer is asking whether it went through.
criteria.topup_reverted: A top-up was reverted, returned or taken back out.
criteria.topup_limits: Limits on how much or how often the customer can top up.
criteria.topup_verification: Verifying a card top-up, top-up verification codes.
criteria.accepted_cards_currencies: Which outside cards (such as American Express, another credit card or other cards in general) or which currencies can be used to add money to or top up the account, or which cards and currencies are supported together. Questions about Visa or Mastercard alone belong to the card network option.
criteria.fee_cash_withdrawal: A fee for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
criteria.fee_card_payment: A fee charged for paying with the card, including an extra fee added when buying something from a shop or abroad.
criteria.fee_transfer: A fee for making or receiving a transfer.
criteria.fee_topup: A fee for topping up by card or by bank transfer.
criteria.fee_exchange: A fee or charge for exchanging currency.
criteria.fx_rate: How the exchange rate is set or what rate the customer will get.
criteria.fx_exchange_in_app: How to exchange or convert currency in the app, or which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.fx_currencies_supported: Which currencies the account supports for holding and exchanging.
criteria.fx_wrong_rate_card_payment: The wrong exchange rate was applied to a card purchase made abroad or in a foreign currency.
criteria.fx_wrong_rate_cash: The wrong exchange rate was applied to a cash withdrawal abroad.
criteria.fee_extra_on_statement: An unexplained extra fee or small charge appears on the statement or in the app, or the customer paid a small amount more than expected, and cannot tell what it is for.
criteria.refund_request: The customer wants a refund for a purchase or wants to return an item.
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund that was expected has not appeared.
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice or several times.
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The ATM handed out less cash than requested or the wrong amount; part of the withdrawn cash is missing though the withdrawal went through.
criteria.cancel_purchase: The customer wants to cancel or reverse a purchase or transaction they made by mistake.
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or wants to dispute.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An ATM cash withdrawal the customer did not make.
criteria.card_compromised: The customer thinks someone else used their card or account; unauthorised activity.
criteria.card_lost_or_stolen: The customer reports the card as lost or stolen, and it is still missing.
criteria.phone_lost_or_stolen: The customer's phone was lost or stolen.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten app passcode, resetting the passcode, cannot log in.
criteria.identity_verify_how: What documents are needed and how to verify identity.
criteria.identity_verify_failed: Identity verification is not working or the app cannot verify the customer.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in or where the account can be used.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address or phone number.
criteria.unexpected_money_in: Money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there.
